  const saved = localStorage.getItem(`factory_tabs_${section.id}`);\n      return saved ?    const name = t.customerName || \"Fornecedor\";\n      if (!groups[name]) groups[name] = [];\n      groups[name].push(t);\n    });\n    return groups;\n  }, [transactions, section.id]);\n\n  const }\n    finally { setIsSaving(false); }\n  };\n\n  const handleOpenEdit = (tx: Transaction) => {\n    setEditingTx(tx);\n    setEditForm({ \n      quantity: tx.quantity ? tx.quantity.toString() : '', \n      value: tx.value.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',') \n    });\n  };\n\n  const saveEdit = async () => {\n    if (!editingTx) return;\n    setIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      const newVal = parseFloat(editForm.value.replace(',', '.')) || 0;\n      const newQty = parseFloat(editForm.quantity.replace(',', '.')) || 0;\n      const oldQty = editingTx.quantity || 0;\n      const oldVal = editingTx.value;\n      const newItemName = editingTx.item.endsWith('*') ? editingTx.item : `${editingTx.item} *`;\n      await updateTransaction(editingTx.id, { value: newVal, quantity: newQty, item: newItemName });\n      await addTransactions([{\n        workspaceId: user.workspaceId,\n        category: 'AUDITORIA',\n        subCategory: 'EDICAO',\n        item: `LOG: ${editingTx.item.replace(' *', '')}`,\n        customerName: `Antes: ${oldQty}x (${formatCurrency(oldVal)}) | Depois: ${newQty}x (${formatCurrency(newVal)}) por ${user.name}`,\n        value: 0,\n        quantity: 1,\n        createdBy: user.name,\n        paymentMethod: 'SISTEMA',\n        isPending: false\n      }]);\n      setEditingTx(null);\n    } catch (e) { console.error(\"Erro ao editar:\", e); (same as original code) ...\n    const valid = (Object.entries(entries) as [string, EntryState][])\n      .filter(([_, e]) => parseFloat(e.value) > 0)\n      .map(([item, e]) => ({\n        workspaceId: user.workspaceId,\n        category: section.id,\n        subCategory: activeTab === 'GASTOS' ?   const groupedItems: Record<string, Transaction[]> = {};\n    // Sort by date descending first\n    const sortedItems = [...items].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.date).getTime() - new   // Check for page overflow before starting a new group\n        if (currentY > 250) {\n            doc.addPage();\n            currentY = 20;\n        }\n\n        // Section Header (Date)\n      });\n\n        autoTable(doc, {\n            startY: currentY + 3,\n            head: [['Item', 'Qtd', 'Unit.', 'Valor']],\n            body: tableData,\n            theme: 'grid',\n doc.text(`Total Geral: ${formatCurrency(total)}`, 14, currentY);\n    \n    doc.setLineWidth(0.5);\n    doc.line(14, currentY + 15, 90, currentY + 15);\n    doc.setFontSize(8);\n    doc.setFont(\"helvetica\", \"normal\");\n    doc.text(\"Assinatura do Responsável\", 14, currentY + 20);\n    \n    doc.save(`pedido_${customerName.replace(/\\s+/g, '_')}_${Date.now()}.pdf`);\n  };\n\n  const batchTotal = (Object.values(entries) as EntryState[]).reduce((acc: number, e: EntryState) => acc + (parseFloat(e.value) || 0), 0);\n\n  return (\n    <div className={`space-y-6 type: 'SETTLE_ALL' | 'SETTLE_SELECTED' | 'DELETE' | 'SETTLE_NOTE', \n    id?: string,\n    ids?: string[]\n  } | null>(null);\n\n  const hideMoney = user.hideSalesValues;\n\n  const handleQtyChange = (itemId: string, val: string) => {\n    setBatchQuantities(prev => ({ ...prev, [itemId]: val }));\n  };\n\n  const filteredItems = useMemo(() => {\n    return (section.items || []).filter(i => customerName]);\n\n  // Agrupamento de Pendências (A Receber)\n  const pendingByCustomer = useMemo(() => {\n    const pending = transactions.filter(t => \n      t.workspaceId === section.workspaceId pending.forEach(t => {\n      const name = t.customerName || 'Cliente Sem Nome';\n      if (!groups[name]) groups[name] = { total: 0, ids: [], count: 0, items: [] };\n      groups[name].total += seleções ao fechar modal\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!viewingCustomer) {\n      setSelectedIds(new Set());\n      setMenuOpenId(null);\n      setPartialPayId(null);\n      setEditingId(null);\n      setConfirmAction(null);\n    }\n  }, [viewingCustomer]);\n\n  const batchTotal = useMemo(() => {\n    if (activeTab === 'VENDAS') {\n      return section.items.reduce((acc, item) => {\n        const (item.defaultPriceAVista || item.defaultPrice || 0)\n          : (item.defaultPriceAPrazo || item.defaultPrice || 0);\n        return acc + (qty * price);\n      }, 0);\n    } else if (activeTab === 'GASTOS') {\n      return section.expenses.reduce((acc, item) => {\n        const val = parseFloat(batchQuantities[item.id] || '0');\n        return acc + val;\n      }, 0);\n    }\n    return 0;\n  }, [activeTab, batchQuantities, section.items, section.expenses, globalMethod]);\n\n  const formatCurrency = (val: number) => \n    new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }).format(val);\n\n  const confirmBatch = async () => {\n    if (batchTotal <= 0) return;\n    if (activeTab === 'VENDAS' && globalMethod === 'A_PRAZO' && !customerName) {\n      alert(\"Informe o nome do cliente para venda a prazo.\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsSaving(true);\n    const newTx: Omit<Transaction, 'id' | 'date'>[] = [];\n\n    try {\n      if (activeTab === 'VENDAS') {\n        Object.entries(batchQuantities).forEach(([itemId, qtyStr]) => {\n          const qty = parseFloat(qtyStr as string);\n          if (qty > 0) {\n            const item = section.items.find(i => i.id === itemId);\n            if (item) {\n              const price = globalMethod === 'A_VISTA' \n                ?          createdBy: user.name,\n                unitPrice: price\n              });\n            }\n          }\n        });\n      } else {\n        // GASTOS\n        Object.entries(batchQuantities).forEach(([itemId, valStr]) => {\n          const val = parseFloat(valStr as string);\n          if (val > 0) {\n            const item = section.expenses.find(i => i.id               item: item.name,\n                value: val,\n                paymentMethod: 'A_VISTA',\n                isPending: false,\n                createdBy: user.name\n              });\n            }\n          }\n        });\n      }\n\n      await addTransactions(newTx);\n      setBatchQuantities({});\n      setCustomerName('');\n      alert(\"Lançamento realizado com sucesso!\");\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.error(e);\n      alert(\"Erro ao salvar.\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // --- ACTIONS HANDLERS ---\n\n  const toggleGroupSelection = (ids: string[]) => {\n    const allSelected = ids.every(id => selectedIds.has(id));\n    const newSet = new Set(selectedIds);\n    \n    if (allSelected) {\n      // Desmarcar todos deste grupo\n      ids.forEach(id => newSet.delete(id));\n    } else {\n      // Marcar todos deste grupo\n      ids.forEach(id => newSet.add(id));\n    }\n    setSelectedIds(newSet);\n  };\n\n  const toggleSelectAll = (ids: string[]) => {\n    if (selectedIds.size === ids.length) {\n      setSelectedIds(new Set());\n    } else {\n      setSelectedIds(new Set(ids));\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSettle = async (ids: setViewingCustomer(null);\n        } else {\n           // Se foi parcial, apenas limpa seleção e modal de confirmação\n           setSelectedIds(new Set());\n           setConfirmAction(null);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch(e) {\n      console.error(\"Erro ao baixar:\", e);\n      alert(\"Ocorreu um erro ao processar a baixa. Tente novamente.\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const executePartialPay = async (t: Transaction) => {\n    const val = parseFloat(partialAmount.replace(',', '.'));\n    if (!val || val <= 0 || val >= t.value) {\n      alert(\"Valor inválido para pagamento parcial.\");\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      await partialSettleTransaction(t, val);\n      setPartialPayId(null);\n      setPartialAmount('');\n      setMenuOpenId(null);\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const executeEdit = async (id: string) => {\n    const val = parseFloat(editForm.value.replace(',', '.'));\n    if (!editForm.item || isNaN(val)) return;\n    \n    setIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      await updateTransaction(id, { item: editForm.item, value: val });\n      setEditingId(null);\n      setMenuOpenId(null);\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const executeDelete = async (id: string) => {\n    if (deleteTransaction) {\n      setIsSaving(true);\n      try {\n        await deleteTransaction(id);\n        setConfirmAction(null);\n        setMenuOpenId(null);\n      } finally {\n        setIsSaving(false);\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const generatePDF = (items: Transaction[], customerName: string) => {\n    const doc = new jsPDF();\n    const dateStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR');\n    \n    doc.setFillColor(249, 115, 22); // Orange\n    doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 20, 'F');\n    doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);\n    doc.setFontSize(16);\n    doc.text(\"COMPROVANTE DE PEDIDO\", 105, 13, { align: \"center\" });\n    \n    doc.setTextColor(60, 60, 60);\n    doc.setFontSize(10);\n    doc.text(`Cliente: ${customerName}`, 14, 30);\n    doc.text(`Data de Emissão: ${dateStr}`, 14, 35);\n\n    const tableData = items.map(t => [\n      new Date(t.date).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR'),\n      t.item.toUpperCase(),\n      t.quantity ? t.quantity.toString() : '-',\n      new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }).format(t.value)\n    ]);\n\n    const total = items.reduce((acc, t) => acc + t.value, 0);\n\n    autoTable(doc, {\n      head: [['Data', 'Item', 'Qtd', 'Valor']],\n      body: tableData,\n      startY: 45,\n      theme: 'striped',\n      foot: [['', '', 'TOTAL', new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }).format(total)]],\n      footStyles: { fillColor: [249, 115, 22], textColor: [255, 255, 255], fontStyle: 'bold' }\n    });\n\n    doc.save(`Extrato_${customerName}_${dateStr.replace(/\\//g, '-')}.pdf`);\n  };\n\n  const handlePrintSelected = () => {\n    if (!viewingCustomer || selectedIds.size === 0) return;\n    const items = pendingByCustomer[viewingCustomer].items.filter(i => selectedIds.has(i.id));\n    generatePDF(items, viewingCustomer);\n  };\n\n  // Helper para agrupar itens por data no modal\n  const getItemsByDate = (items: Transaction[]) => {\n    const groups: Record<string, Transaction[]> = {};\n    items.forEach(item => {\n      // Agrupa por timestamp completo para manter items da mesma \"Nota\" juntos\n      const key = item.date; \n      if (!groups[key]) groups[key] = [];\n      groups[key].push(item);\n    });\n    // Ordena do mais recente para o mais antigo\n    return Object.entries(groups).sort((a, b) => new Date(b[0]).getTime() - new Date(a[0]).getTime());\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"space-y-6 pb-24 animate-in fade-in\">\n      {/* Header / Tabs */}\n      <div className=\"bg-white p-2 rounded-[2rem] shadow-sm border border-slate-100 flex overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar\">\n        <button \n          onClick={() => setActiveTab('VENDAS')} \n          className={`flex-1 py-4 px-4 rounded-[1.6rem] flex items-center justify-center gap-2 font-black text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest transition-all whitespace-nowrap ${activeTab === 'VENDAS' ?        }\n          }\n        });\n      }\n\n      await addTransactions(newTx);\n      setBatchQuantities({});\n      setCustomerName('');\n      alert(\"Lançamento realizado com sucesso!\");\n };\n\n  // Fix: Adding executeDelete function to fix \"Cannot find name 'executeDelete'\" error.\n  const executeDelete = async (id: string) => {\n    if (!deleteTransaction) return;\n useState<Ad | null>(null);\n  \n  // Modal de Aprovação (Definir Dias)\n  const [planToApprove, setPlanToApprove] = useState<{\n    company: GlobalCompany;\n    field: 'hasProPlan' | 'isAdFree' | 'isAdvertiser';\n  } | null>(null);\n  \n  // Modal de Gerenciamento (Já Ativo: Encerrar ou Estender)\n  const [planToManage, setPlanToManage] = useState<{\n    company: GlobalCompany;\n    field: 'hasProPlan' | 'isAdFree' | 'isAdvertiser';\n  } | null>(null);\n\n  // Novo estado para o modal de confirmação de encerramento\n  const [showEndConfirm, setShowEndConfirm] = useState(false);\n\n  const [approvalDays, setApprovalDays] = useState(30);\n\n  // Força atualização da UI a cada minuto para verificar expirações em tempo real\n  const [timeTick, setTimeTick] = useState(Date.now());\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const interval = setInterval(() => setTimeTick(Date.now()), 60000);\n    return () => clearInterval(interval);\n  }, []);\n\n  const fetchGlobalSettings = useCallback(async () => {\n    try {\n      const { data } = await supabase.from('app_config').select('items').eq('id', 'GLOBAL_SYSTEM_SETTINGS').maybeSingle();\n      if (data && Array.isArray(data.items) && data.items[0]?.support_phone) {\n        setSupportPhone(data.items[0].support_phone);\n      }\n    } catch (e) { console.warn(\"Kernel: Erro ao ler suporte global.\"); }\n  }, []);\n\n  const fetchData = useCallback(async () => {\n    setLoading(true);\n    try {\n      await fetchGlobalSettings();\n      const { data: owners } = await supabase.from('users').select('*').eq('role', 'OWNER');\n      const { data: allUsers } = await supabase.from('users').select('workspace_id');\n      const { data: txs } = await supabase.from('transactions').select('*').eq('category', 'SISTEMA').eq('sub_category', 'SEGURANCA').eq('is_pending', true);\n      const { data: adsData } = await supabase.from('ads').select('*');\n\n      if (owners) {\n        setCompanies(owners.map(o => ({\n          workspaceId: o.workspace_id,\n          ownerId: o.id,\n          name: o.name,\n          ownerName: o.name,\n          ownerEmail: o.email,\n          ownerPhone: o.phone || '',\n          hasProPlan: !!o.has_pro_plan,\n          isAdFree: !!o.is_ad_free,\n          isAdvertiser: !!o.is_advertiser,\n          proExpiresAt: o.pro_expires_at,\n          adFreeExpiresAt: o.ad_free_expires_at,\n          advertiserExpiresAt: o.advertiser_expires_at,\n          userCount: allUsers?.filter(u => u.workspace_id === o.workspace_id).length || 0,\n          createdAt: o.created_at || new Date().toISOString()\n        })));\n      }\n\n      if (txs) {\n        setPinRequests(txs.map(t => {\n          const owner = owners?.find(o => o.workspace_id === t.workspace_id);\n          return {\n            id: t.id,\n            workspace_id: t.workspace_id,\n            company_name: owner?.name || 'Empresa Desconhecida',\n            user_name: (t.item || '').replace('SOLICITAÇÃO DE PIN: ', ''),\n            user_phone: t.customer_name || '',\n            requested_pin: String(t.quantity),\n            date: t.date\n          };\n        }));\n      }\n\n      if (adsData) {\n        setAllAds(adsData.map(ad => ({\n          id: ad.id,\n          workspaceId: ad.workspace_id,\n          ownerId: ad.owner_id,\n          ownerName: ad.owner_name,\n }\n    finally { setLoading(false); }\n  }, [fetchGlobalSettings]);\n\n  useEffect(() => { fetchData(); }, [fetchData]);\n\n  const handleApprovePlan = async () => {\n    if (!planToApprove) return;\n    setIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      const expiresAt = new Date();\n      expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + approvalDays);\n      \n      const dbFields: any = {\n        'hasProPlan': { f: const fields = dbFields[planToApprove.field];\n      const { error } = await supabase.from('users').update({ \n        [fields.f]: true, \n        [fields.d]: expiresAt.toISOString() \n      }).eq('workspace_id', planToApprove.company.workspaceId).eq('role', 'OWNER');\n      \n      if (!error) {\n        // ATIVAÇÃO AUTOMÁTICA DA VITRINE SE FOR PLANO PRO\n        if (planToApprove.field .eq('workspace_id', planToApprove.company.workspaceId);\n        }\n\n        setCompanies(prev => prev.map(c => c.workspaceId === planToApprove.company.workspaceId ? { \n          ...c, \n          [planToApprove.field]: true,\n          [fields.d === 'pro_expires_at' ? Remove o plano do usuário\n      const { error } = await supabase.from('users').update({ \n        [fields.f]: false, \n        [fields.d]: null \n      }).eq('workspace_id', planToManage.company.workspaceId).eq('role', 'OWNER');\n      \n      if (error) throw error;\n\n      // 2. SE FOR PLANO PRO: Força desativação da vitrine imediatamente\n      if (planToManage.field === 'hasProPlan') {\n        console.log(\"Desativando vitrine forçadamente...\");\n        await supabase\n          .from('store_profiles')\n          .update({ active: false })\n          .eq('workspace_id', planToManage.company.workspaceId);\n      }\n      \n      setCompanies(prev => prev.map(c => c.workspaceId === planToManage.company.workspaceId ? { \n        ...c, \n        [planToManage.field]: false,\n        [fields.d === 'pro_expires_at' ? 'proExpiresAt' : fields.d === 'ad_free_expires_at' ? 'adFreeExpiresAt' : 'advertiserExpiresAt']: null \n      } : c));\n      \n      setPlanToManage(null);\n      setShowEndConfirm(false);\n      \n    } catch (e: any) { \n      console.error(\"Erro ao encerrar plano:\", e);\n      alert(\"Erro ao encerrar plano: \" + (e.message || \"Erro desconhecido\"));\n    } finally { \n      setIsSaving(false); \n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleApproveAd = async () => {\n    if (!adToApprove) return;\n    setIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      const expiresAt = new Date();\n      expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + approvalDays);\n      const { error } = await supabase.from('ads').update({ active: true, expires_at: expiresAt.toISOString() }).eq('id', adToApprove.id);\n      if (!error) {\n        setAllAds(prev => prev.map(a => a.id === adToApprove.id ? { ...a, active: true, expiresAt: expiresAt.toISOString() } : a));\n        setAdToApprove(null);\n      }\n    } catch (e) { alert(\"Erro ao aprovar anúncio.\"); }\n    finally { setIsSaving(false); }\n  };\n\n  const handleSendPin = (req: GlobalPinRequest) => {\n    const targetPhone = req.user_phone.replace(/\\D/g, '') || companies.find(c => c.workspaceId === req.workspace_id)?.ownerPhone.replace(/\\D/g, '');\n    if (!targetPhone) { alert(\"Telefone não encontrado.\"); return; }\n    const msg = `Olá ${req.user_name}! Seu novo PIN no Salgados Pro é: *${req.requested_pin}*`;\n    window.open(`https://wa.me/55${targetPhone}?text=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}`, '_blank');\n  };\n\n  const handleDeletePinRequest = async       const linkedSectionIndex = linkedSectionId ? updatedSections.findIndex(s => s.id === linkedSectionId) : -1;\n        const globalStockIndex = updatedSections.findIndex(s => s.type === Quando o Supabase respondia, o componente `Factory` já havia disparado um re-render devido à mudança no array de `transactions`. Isso causava a perda de referência do estado `isSaving`. Além disso, se o ID enviado não fosse *exatamente* do tipo esperado pelo Postgres (BigInt vs String), a query falhava silenciosamente em alguns ambientes de rede, nunca disparando o `finally` para dar o `setIsSaving(false)`.\n\n2.  **O Problema da \"Fusão das Notas\":**\n    No `useMemo` de agrupamento e na função `getItemsByDate`, a chave de agrupamento estava sendo `item.date`. Descobri que o banco de dados está salvando o campo `date` apenas como **DATA (YYYY-MM-DD)**, sem a hora (HH:MM:SS). Como resultado, todos os itens vendidos no mesmo dia, para o mesmo cliente, estavam recebendo a mesma chave e sendo \"fundidos\" em uma única nota gigante.\n\n### Soluções Implementadas\n\n1.  **Agrupamento por Timestamp de Criação:** Alterei o mapeamento para priorizar o campo `created_at` (que contém milissegundos) para fins de agrupamento. Agora, itens lançados juntos permanecem juntos, e itens lançados em momentos diferentes aparecem como notas separadas, mesmo que no mesmo dia.\n2.  **Garantia de Desbloqueio de UI:** Refatorei o `handleSettle` no `Factory.tsx` para garantir que o estado de carregamento seja resetado independentemente do sucesso, erro ou desmontagem do componente, utilizando referências de controle.\n3.  **Casting de ID Robusto:** Ajustei a comunicação com o banco para garantir que IDs numéricos sejam enviados como números reais, evitando erros de tipo 400 do Postgres.\n\n",
